subject: ENGLISH
title: Retell It in Order · M01 D19
objective: Retell a story in beginning-middle-ending order.
introduction: A retelling uses key events in order and the learner’s own words, not every sentence. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: To tell a story again in your own words.
A tale with characters and events.
The last part of a story or word.

items.prompt: Which statement best matches “Retell It in Order”?
